commentaire: Activation manifest of the Kybernos satellites. A satellite = a @local/* bundle independent of the base. The base (tier 1) is always shipped; tiers 2 and 3 are optional and can be switched on one by one. `obligatoire: true` = the base needs it (slot declared by the master); `false` = can be unplugged without breakage.

socle.commentaire: Always shipped. No activation option: the master declares the slots of these bundles, it cannot do without them.

bundles.role: master: 20 client modules, 30+ host routes, tool kybernos_report_feedback
hub: tracks whether startups lead to a usable GUI, recommends safe mode (stays active in safe mode)
registry of plugins: reads the data plugins installed on this computer, checks them, publishes window.__KB__ and the host seam
theme (mode, palettes, background, font) — language and RTL are in the kybernos-language satellite
sessions, hot-file guard, categories
skills, marketplace — slot 'main.kybernos-skills' declared by the master

satellites.commentaire: Can be unplugged. tier 2 = independent, tier 3 = heavy rendering modules (third-party libs).

bundles.role: interface language: ISO list, LLM translation of Kybernos and of the DSH screens, dir/lang on <html>
DSH relaunch, tool relancer_dsh
Composio connectors
cloud, memory, tools memory_search/memory_write
model catalogue
slash (/) commands

message between chats: the agent proposes an inline form (a message or an instruction, to another chat, to a new one or to this one), the person edits and sends it, with the sent trail and the received card
tells you when an automation finished, failed or waits for you: a floating window, a system banner and a badge, each with a link back to the right page of Kybernos; its own Settings page "Widget"
maintenance, tool install_bundle
reorderable queue (drag), auto-continue, route /kybernos/queue-move
free OpenCode Zen models without an account: gateway /free-llms/v1, Settings panel, activation in the wizard
Auto mode: routing of delegations by class, whitelist, per-session state
Bricks panel: isometric mockups driven by the chat, tool animer_briques
Slides panel: decks written live by the chat, tool creer_slides
Modeller panel: 2D/3D models driven by the chat, tool modeliser
Motion panel: animations (titles, charts, counters, particles, 3D, characters, sound) made by the chat, MP4 export, tool creer_motion
“Install as app”: exports a right-sidebar panel as a native app
cloud computers for agents (E2B, key supplied by the user)
Workers connectors: the DSH subagent providers for OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code and Hermes, turned on from the Workers page
Workers screen: verified state, install and exposure to the main agent for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Qwen, Hermes and ZCode
local models panel: detects the machine, installs an Ollama model
markdown links in messages as reference chips

the phone: DSH usable on a narrow screen (sidebar as a drawer, Settings stacked, below 700 px only) and, on a paid plan, a QR code that links a phone to this computer through the Kybernos relay, end to end encrypted
web search for the agents with or without an API key: free engines out of the box, keyed engines when you add one, one fallback chain
Memory & Lessons learned page (account memory + lessons per Agent Team), lessons injected per session, switches, tools lesson_write/lesson_search
Atlas: read-only map of projects, agent teams, skills, memory, automations and apps, with what is broken or unused
a chip under the composer: where the work stands (changed, saved, on GitHub, in the project) and what to do next; Simple / Developer mode; replaces the four git pills of Sessions while it is active

a chip under the composer and a Settings page: the busiest window of your plan (given by the server, as a percentage) or the session cost on your own key; the detail by day, model and session; a budget that warns

workspaces with or without a folder: Create offers a private folder in Documents/Kybernos, and the Details tab shows where the workspace works; execution and devices are a greyed-out preview of the next versions
phone app only: runs commands, search (rg), a shell and MCP servers inside the app, where a phone cannot launch programs; leave it off on a computer
voice calls from any session (button under the message, Settings › Calls page, member voice, languages, cloned voice and face optional); the Call / Video buttons of team members only appear with it
rendering of ```mermaid fences as SVG
viewer for SQLite/Postgres databases
audio/video player in the sidebar
chat command blocks dressed as a terminal, with a button to run them
Dashboards page before Agent Teams: dashboards built by chat, with a live preview in the right sidebar
a Summary tab in the chat's right-hand panel: the agents, the task list, the skills and tools used and the files written, read in the browser from what the chat already contains
a Kyber tab in the chat's right-hand panel: where your assistant answers you (Telegram) and the cloud computer it works on, read from the server
the Kaby page in Settings: the assistant's name, portrait and voice, and the face of its video calls with its own keys
search everywhere: the content of chats, skills, memories, lessons, creations, automations and teams
the Servers page: add a Kybernos server from its address, switch between servers, rename and remove them

ordre_montage.commentaire: Order of dsh.profile.bundles. The base first, then the satellites activated in that order. A deactivated satellite is simply left out of the list.
